title: szeret and utál + Infinitive: Travel Preferences

sections.title: Saying what you like and hate doing
sections.content: You already use szeret ("to like/love") with an infinitive — szeretek olvasni, "I like to read". utál ("to hate") and imád ("to adore, to love") work exactly the same way: verb, then the infinitive of whatever you like, hate, or adore doing. Utálok korán kelni ("I hate getting up early"), Imádok vonattal utazni ("I love traveling by train").

items.english: I like traveling by train because it's comfortable.

items.spanish: Utálok korán kelni, de imádok új helyeket látni.
items.english: I hate getting up early, but I love seeing new places.

sections.content: All three verbs conjugate for person the normal way — szeretek, szeretsz, szeret... — only the infinitive after them stays fixed.
